title: TableDossier profile
description: Canonical, engine-independent result of one profiling run. Documentation is derived from this document only. Version 1.3 only adds to 1.2 (PostgreSQL engine and local CLI context, server version, transaction snapshot consistency, connect error stage, system catalog constraints), which only adds to 1.1 (exact uniqueness, referential validation, relationship hypotheses), which only adds to 1.0 (deep level). See docs/contract.md.

referential_validation.description: 1.2: run-level record of referential validation (null below the deep level).

relationship_hypotheses.description: 1.2: data-driven relationship hypotheses, kept apart from known relationships (null below the deep level).

reference_time.description: Reference instant used by temporal metrics (after_reference_count).

effective_config.description: Configuration after applying defaults, generated values and widgets. It never contains credentials.

execution_context.description: 1.3: adds local_cli (a run of the tabledossier command line).

stage.description: 1.3: adds connect (the connection failed or was lost during the run).

deep.description: 1.1: what the deep level covered and what its budgets limited (null at other levels).

uniqueness.description: 1.2: exact uniqueness of keys (null below the deep level).

mode.description: 1.3: adds transaction_snapshot (every read of the table used one database transaction snapshot).

version_timestamp.description: 1.3: for transaction_snapshot, the UTC start of the snapshot transaction; for pinned_delta_version, the commit time of that version.

nullable.description: Nullability declared by the source schema (not observed).

element_context.description: 1.1: set for profiled array elements and map entries; their denominators are elements or entries.

json_paths.description: 1.1: JSON path catalogue of a string field (deep level).

source.description: 1.3: adds system_catalog (constraints read from the database's system catalog, e.g. PostgreSQL pg_catalog).

validation_detail.description: 1.2: why the relationship is validated, violated or not validated.

uniquenessKey.description: 1.2: exact uniqueness of one key (one or more columns) over the analysed scope. Only counts are recorded, never key values.

hypothesis.description: 1.2: a data-driven relationship hypothesis. It is never a known relationship, has no cardinality and is never drawn as an ER edge.
